notes.title: Hey! I´m here and still working!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31501445/d6c2c23d1921d591be048bbbfbe6d48e60001137.gif[/img]

Hi guys, not much to say since the release date, a couple of bugs have been fixed, but the real work hasn´t been done yet. As you know, I´m a single developer and student, so creating content for videogames is something I do in my spare time. 
Anyways...I´m still working on Beach Rules and on new projects at the same time, updates will come, eventually, but I can´t give a date. 

This is what I have at the moment, but no introduced to game yet:
[list]
[*] 2 new minigames (swimming and sand castle contest)
[*] 1 new mechanic to earn extra coins
[*] New sprites people and stuff 
[/list]

And this is what I want to do in the future:
[list]
[*] 2 more minigames
[*] Triathlon mode (single and local multipayer)
[/list]

Please, let me know what you think and if youñd like to see anything else in the game.

Regards,
Rubén

tags.bug: a couple of bugs have been fixed
